categories.label: PDF tools
categories.description: Convert, edit and secure PDF documents

tools.title: Compress PDF
tools.subtitle: Smaller file, same pages
tools.description: Reduce file size by recompressing images and cleaning redundant objects. Text stays selectable.
limitations: Documents that are already optimised may shrink very little.

tools.title: CSV to Excel
tools.subtitle: Real spreadsheet
tools.description: Turn a CSV file into a formatted .xlsx workbook with detected numbers and a frozen header.

tools.title: Delete pages
tools.subtitle: Remove unwanted pages
tools.description: Remove specific pages from a PDF and download the cleaned document.

options.label: Pages
options.help: Use page numbers and ranges, separated by commas.

tools.title: Excel to CSV
tools.subtitle: Plain data
tools.description: Export each worksheet of an .xlsx workbook to a UTF-8 CSV file.

tools.title: Excel to PDF
tools.subtitle: Spreadsheets, printable
tools.description: Render an Excel workbook as PDF, keeping sheets, cell values and table structure.
limitations: Very large sheets are trimmed in the built-in fallback renderer (2,000 rows per sheet).
Charts and macros are not rendered by the fallback engine.

tools.title: Extract pages
tools.subtitle: Keep only what you need
tools.description: Select pages and rebuild a new PDF containing exactly those pages, in your chosen order.

options.label: Pages
options.help: Use page numbers and ranges, separated by commas.

tools.title: HTML to PDF
tools.subtitle: Web page archive
tools.description: Convert an HTML file into a paginated PDF. Remote resources are intentionally not loaded.
limitations: External images, scripts and remote stylesheets are stripped for privacy and safety.
JavaScript-rendered content is not executed.

tools.title: Compress image
tools.subtitle: Smaller photos
tools.description: Shrink photos for email or the web with adjustable quality and an optional maximum size.

tools.title: Convert image format
tools.subtitle: JPEG, PNG, WebP
tools.description: Convert between JPEG, PNG and WebP, with white background flattening for transparency.

options.label: Quality
options.help: Lower quality produces smaller files.

tools.title: Resize image
tools.subtitle: Exact or proportional
tools.description: Resize by percentage, by width, by longest edge or to exact dimensions, without distortion.

tools.title: Rotate image
tools.subtitle: Fix orientation
tools.description: Rotate an image by 90, 180 or 270 degrees, optionally mirrored.

tools.title: Images to PDF
tools.subtitle: JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC
tools.description: Combine one or many images into a PDF with A4, Letter or image-sized pages, margins and custom order.

options.label: Image quality
options.help: Lower quality produces smaller files.

options.label: Page order
options.help: Leave blank to keep the upload order.

tools.title: Image to Text (OCR)
tools.subtitle: Copyable text
tools.description: Extract the words from an image into a plain text file, with the language of your choice.

options.label: OCR language
options.help: Choose the language of the text. Auto uses English and French when available.

limitations: OCR accuracy depends on image quality, contrast and font.

tools.title: Image to Word
tools.subtitle: OCR to editable .docx
tools.description: Read the text in a photo or scan and build an editable Word document with reconstructed paragraphs.

options.label: OCR language
options.help: Choose the language of the text. Auto uses English and French when available.

limitations: OCR cannot reproduce the original formatting, fonts or images faithfully.
Handwriting and low-resolution photos reduce accuracy.

tools.title: Merge PDFs
tools.subtitle: Combine several files
tools.description: Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file, in the order you choose, with optional bookmarks.

options.label: Add a bookmark per source file

limitations: Encrypted PDFs must be unlocked before merging.

tools.title: Add page numbers
tools.subtitle: Number every page
tools.description: Stamp page numbers at the top or bottom of the page in a style of your choice.

tools.title: Extract images from PDF
tools.subtitle: Original embedded images
tools.description: Pull the original pictures embedded in a PDF, without re-rendering the pages.
limitations: Only true embedded images are extracted; vector graphics and full-page scans stored as masks may be skipped.

tools.title: PDF to Excel
tools.subtitle: Detect tables
tools.description: Detect ruled tables in a PDF and export them as editable worksheets.
limitations: Works best with ruled tables. Merged cells, nested tables and scanned pages without OCR may not be detected.

tools.title: PDF to JPEG
tools.subtitle: Page images
tools.description: Render every page as a high quality JPEG image. Choose the resolution and get a ZIP for multi-page files.

options.label: Pages
options.help: Use page numbers and ranges, separated by commas.

options.label: Resolution (DPI)
options.help: Higher DPI means sharper images and larger files.

options.label: Quality
options.help: Lower quality produces smaller files.

limitations: Text is no longer selectable in image output.

tools.title: PDF to PNG
tools.subtitle: Lossless page images
tools.description: Render pages as lossless PNG images that stay crisp at high resolution.

options.label: Pages
options.help: Use page numbers and ranges, separated by commas.

options.label: Resolution (DPI)
options.help: Higher DPI means sharper images and larger files.

limitations: PNG files are larger than JPEG for photographic pages.

tools.title: Scanned PDF to searchable PDF
tools.subtitle: Add an OCR text layer
tools.description: Run OCR over scanned pages and add an invisible text layer so the document can be searched, selected and copied.

options.label: OCR language
options.help: Choose the language of the text. Auto uses English and French when available.

options.label: Resolution (DPI)
options.help: Higher DPI means sharper images and larger files.

options.label: Re-run OCR on pages that already have text

limitations: OCR accuracy depends on scan quality; handwriting and unusual fonts are not reliable.
The visual appearance of the page is unchanged.

tools.title: Split PDF into single pages
tools.subtitle: One PDF per page
tools.description: Create separate PDF files for every page of a document, delivered together in a ZIP archive.

tools.title: PDF to Text
tools.subtitle: Plain .txt
tools.description: Extract the text of a PDF into a clean UTF-8 text file with optional page markers.

options.label: Pages
options.help: Use page numbers and ranges, separated by commas.

options.label: Use OCR for pages without text
options.help: Slower, but works for scanned documents.

options.label: OCR language
options.help: Choose the language of the text. Auto uses English and French when available.

limitations: Layout, images and formatting are not part of plain text output.

tools.title: PDF to Word
tools.subtitle: Editable .docx
tools.description: Rebuild an editable Word document with paragraphs, headings, tables and images kept in place. Scanned PDFs are handled with OCR.

options.label: Conversion mode
options.help: Automatic detects scanned pages and chooses OCR only when needed.

options.label: OCR language
options.help: Choose the language of the text. Auto uses English and French when available.

limitations: Complex multi-column layouts and mathematical formulas may not be reconstructed exactly.
Scanned documents are rebuilt from OCR text, so fonts and spacing will differ from the scan.

tools.title: PowerPoint to PDF
tools.subtitle: Slides as a document
tools.description: Convert .pptx presentations into PDF slides.
limitations: Requires the LibreOffice renderer on the server.

tools.title: Protect PDF
tools.subtitle: Password and permissions
tools.description: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256 and decide whether readers may print or copy content.

options.label: Open password
options.help: Needed to open the document. It is never stored on our servers.

options.label: Owner password (optional)
options.help: Controls permissions; defaults to the open password.

limitations: A forgotten password cannot be recovered. Keep a safe copy of the original file.

tools.title: Reorder pages
tools.subtitle: Rearrange the document
tools.description: Change the order of pages by listing the new sequence, for example 3,1,2.

options.label: New page order
options.help: List every page exactly once.

tools.title: Rotate pages
tools.subtitle: Fix orientation
tools.description: Rotate all pages or a selection by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

options.label: Pages
options.help: Use page numbers and ranges, separated by commas.

tools.title: Split PDF
tools.subtitle: By page or range
tools.description: Split a document into one file per page, into fixed-size chunks, or by custom page ranges.

choices.label: Fixed number of pages per file

options.label: Ranges
options.help: Separate each output file with a semicolon.

tools.title: Text to PDF
tools.subtitle: Neat, printable page
tools.description: Lay out a plain text file as a clean, printable PDF with Unicode support.

tools.title: Unlock PDF
tools.subtitle: Remove a password you own
tools.description: Remove password protection from a PDF by supplying the correct password. Only use this on documents you are authorized to modify.

options.label: Current password
options.help: Only works with the valid password.

limitations: Without the correct password the file cannot be unlocked.

tools.title: Watermark PDF
tools.subtitle: Confidential, Draft, sample…
tools.description: Add a diagonal or footer watermark to some or all pages with adjustable opacity.

options.label: Pages
options.help: Use page numbers and ranges, separated by commas.

tools.title: Word to HTML
tools.subtitle: Ready-to-publish page
tools.description: Turn a Word document into a clean, responsive HTML page with inline styles and embedded images.
limitations: Complex Word tables and headers/footers may be simplified in HTML output.

tools.title: Word to JPEG
tools.subtitle: Page images
tools.description: Render each page of a Word document as a JPEG image.

options.label: Resolution (DPI)
options.help: Higher DPI means sharper images and larger files.

tools.title: Word to PDF
tools.subtitle: Fixed, shareable layout
tools.description: Convert .docx (and legacy .doc) files to PDF while keeping page size, tables, images and fonts.
limitations: Legacy .doc files require the LibreOffice renderer on the server.
If LibreOffice is not installed, a built-in renderer is used: headers, footers and exact page breaks may differ.

tools.title: Word to PNG
tools.subtitle: Page images
tools.description: Render each page of a Word document as a lossless PNG image.

options.label: Resolution (DPI)
options.help: Higher DPI means sharper images and larger files.

tools.title: Word to Text
tools.subtitle: Clean .txt
tools.description: Extract paragraphs and table content from a Word document into plain UTF-8 text.
